amendments.rule: The Gate 0 evaluation-host matrix is host_matrix below. H-01 and H-02 are required; H-02 is an emulated row, and its timings are never compared with H-01's or reported as performance.

The contributor builds both candidates and runs DS-01 to DS-06 on the owner's standing direction. DS-07 and R-01 to R-09 stay owner-performed; a contributor rehearsal is recorded separately, labeled as such, and never satisfies M-16 or an owner scope.
Candidate tools run in the laboratory under a recorded contributor disposition. That disposition is not a D-018 admission, and selection stays blocked until the owner records admissions.

An epoch binds the shared-input manifest, this overlay, the toolchain record, the runner and the observer by digest. Candidate artifacts are bound per run, so a correction inside the window adds a run to the same epoch while any shared change opens a new epoch for both candidates.

correction_window.rule: After the epoch's first complete run of both candidates, each candidate may receive one round of corrections to its own artifacts for defects that run exposed. The failed run stays archived and is reported beside the corrected run. The window closes before any comparative summary of the corrected run is viewed. A change to a shared input, the runner, the observer, the toolchains or this overlay opens a new epoch that reruns both candidates.

execution.cache: Cold runs start from an empty candidate cache and output root. A warm profile is declared as warm and measured separately.

cpu.declared_parallel: four CPUs and the candidate's declared parallel build setting
cpu.serial: one CPU and the candidate's one-job build setting

environment.candidate_variables: A candidate adapter may add variables its toolchain needs; each is listed, and its value derives from the workspace or toolchain paths, never from the host environment.

execution.filesystem: The toolchain tree and the candidate sources are read-only. Writes go only to the step's output root and temporary directory.
execution.network: Every measured step runs in a new network namespace with no interfaces.
execution.observer: The runner measures wall time with a monotonic clock, CPU time and peak memory from the step's cgroup, and temp and output bytes after the step. Its identity is its raw SHA-256.
execution.timeouts: Each step runs in its own cgroup. At the wall ceiling the whole cgroup is killed and the step is timeout. A memory kill, a temp or output overrun, or the pid limit is resource_exhaustion. Neither is ever success.

execution_order.cold_bootstrap: Runs 1 to 5 alternate: odd runs C-01 then C-02, even runs C-02 then C-01.
execution_order.deterministic_replay: Runs 1 to 3 in each mode alternate the same way; serial before declared_parallel.
execution_order.implementation: Candidate construction alternates which candidate goes first: DS-01 Rocq, DS-02 Lean 4, DS-03 Rocq, DS-04 Lean 4, DS-05 Rocq. Every statement mapping is complete before any timed run or comparative summary is viewed.
execution_order.timed_replay: After one unmeasured warmup per candidate, pairs 1 to 30 alternate the same way within each case; cases run DS-01 to DS-06.
execution_order.workspaces: Workspace W1 completes before W2 is provisioned.

materiality_bands.lean_better: the interval lies above 1 and the ratio is above 1/0.9
materiality_bands.measure: ratio of C-01's median to C-02's, with a paired bootstrap 95% confidence interval
materiality_bands.rocq_better: the interval lies below 1 and the ratio is below 0.9

materiality_bands.inconclusive: a value is missing or a task failed
materiality_bands.lean_better: C-02 at most 0.75 times C-01 on elapsed time
materiality_bands.measure: elapsed owner time and files changed for the same seeded change (one same-owner observation each)
materiality_bands.rocq_better: C-01 at most 0.75 times C-02 on elapsed time

materiality_bands.label: none: M-11 plans audit effort and carries no better or worse label
